title: The New York Times (David Gelles) — Eric on 'the Patagonia of Boats' and the third way for founders
summary: David Gelles — NYT climate correspondent, author of The Man Who Broke Capitalism — profiles Grady-White Boats owner Eddie Smith, who is turning down an estimated $400M sale and instead pledging future profits to charity in a Patagonia-style purpose-trust restructuring. Eric is quoted framing the move as evidence that founders have a third option beyond selling out or letting investors take the wheel.
blockquote: For decades we have taught founders they have only two options: Sell out, or let investors slowly take the wheel. These transactions show a third way is possible: an enduring company built around a long-term mission.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries, quoted in The New York Times
